question: By what name and by whom is this rite recognized as initiation?
premises: The rite is called initiation by name.
It is known and declared as such.
Thinkers on truth declare it so.
inference: Initiation is the established name recognized by those who contemplate truth.
plain_english: Then, O lady of gods, it is known by the name initiation and declared so by thinkers on truth.
